title: sub-V182o_ses-260629 held-out R2 blowups: heavy-tailed low-frequency envelope + small n = test-fold extrapolation
scope: DIAGNOSIS ONLY. Hamm directed 'Do not change the estimator yet; first diagnose whether this comes from design-matrix conditioning, RidgeCV boundary behavior, fold composition, or near-collinear lag features.' No estimator, protocol or result was changed by this work.

adjudication_of_the_four_named_candidate.ridgecv_boundary_behavior: RULED OUT. Blowup cells select alpha at the interior of the grid (median 31.6 for M3; fold-level values 10-100 on the offending folds), and 0.000 of them sit at the grid minimum 0.01, against 0.003 in clean low-n cells. The penalty is not saturating.
adjudication_of_the_four_named_candidate.design_matrix_conditioning: RULED OUT. Condition number of the scaled [Z, L] design is 22.6-30.0 in the blowup cells (Z alone 1.0). The benign high-n comparison case is 4.2. Neither is anywhere near ill-conditioned; a cond of 30 does not produce R2 = -10.
adjudication_of_the_four_named_candidate.near_collinear_lag_features: PRESENT BUT NOT CAUSAL. |corr| between lag features reaches 0.991 in blowup cells, but the benign high-n case reaches 0.833 with no blowup, and ridge is specifically the estimator that tolerates this. Collinearity amplifies the true cause; it does not create it.
adjudication_of_the_four_named_candidate.fold_composition: CONSEQUENTIAL BUT DOWNSTREAM. Fold composition matters only because it decides which fold receives the extreme trial. In unit 95 / theta / omission_p3 / C0_own, folds 0,1,3,4 return R2 +0.13 to +0.25 and fold 2 returns -10.05. It is the trial, not the partition, that is doing the work.

actual_mechanism.statement: The band-power lag features have a HEAVY-TAILED distribution that gets heavier as frequency falls. At omission trial counts there is on average ONE tail trial in the whole condition, so when it lands in a test fold the training set contains NO comparable trial and the fitted ridge must EXTRAPOLATE far outside its training support. The prediction explodes and one trial dominates SS_res.

tail_heaviness_by_band.receipt: unit 95, omission_p3, C0_own, n=139; excess kurtosis and max|z| averaged over the 4 lag features
tail_heaviness_by_band.reading: Monotone in frequency. This is why every blowup cell is theta or alpha and none is high_gamma -- it is a property of the low-frequency envelope, not of omission.

actual_mechanism.extrapolation_receipt: Local trial 41 falls in test fold 2 under the frozen KFold(5, shuffle, seed 0). It lies OUTSIDE the training-fold range on 4 of 4 lag features, at 7.1x / 17.3x / 27.8x / 3.5x the training maximum. The model has never seen anything of that magnitude and its linear extrapolation predicts 38.84 spikes where y = 0. That single trial contributes 79.0% of SS_res.
actual_mechanism.why_high_n_is_immune: The tail FRACTION is essentially identical -- 0.0072 at n=139 (omission_p3) vs 0.0073 at n=822 (matched_empty_p3), and the high-n case actually has a LARGER max|z| of 21.5. What changes is absolute count: ~1 tail trial at n=139 vs ~6 at n=822. At n=822 the training folds always contain tail trials, so there is no extrapolation and pooled R2 is a healthy +0.2279 for the same unit, band and channel set. This is a SMALL-SAMPLE SUPPORT problem, not an omission-condition problem.

the_driving_trial_is_not_a_gross_artifac.identity: omission_p3 local index 41 -> global trial row 254 -> sub-V182o_ses-260629 | t=4033.791833 | trial=558 | condition=RRXR
the_driving_trial_is_not_a_gross_artifac.broadband_amplitude: NOT an outlier. Per-trial peak |LFP| across all channels: median 306.4, this trial 393.7, robust z = 1.5, rank 207 of 961. Only 11 of 512 channels exceed 5x their own median.
the_driving_trial_is_not_a_gross_artifac.band_power: Extreme, and on EVERY PROBE. Theta lag-feature z at this trial: probeA +10.72, probeB +11.21, probeC +6.60, probeD +8.25 -- and on all four probes it is the session MAXIMUM over trials.
the_driving_trial_is_not_a_gross_artifac.interpretation_label: INFERENCE, not observation. A session-wide, all-probe, low-frequency power excursion with unremarkable peak amplitude is the signature of a slow/drift excursion that the causal theta filter integrates into a large sustained envelope. It is NOT a spike-shaped artifact. Whether it is physiological or instrumental is NOT established by anything measured here and must not be asserted.
the_driving_trial_is_not_a_gross_artifac.why_this_matters: An earlier framing of this as 'an artifact trial' would have been wrong and would have licensed a rejection rule that is not justified by the evidence.

separate_unaddressed_finding: 51 trials in sub-V182o_ses-260629 have peak-amplitude robust z > 10 (the top 8 range z = 35.2 to 53.6). There is NO artifact rejection anywhere in this pipeline: the LFP loader's missing_data='drop' drops MISSING samples only. Those 51 trials are a separate issue from the blowups -- trial 254 is not among them -- and are recorded here, unfixed, because fixing them is a protocol change.

impact_on_reported_results.Q1: UNAFFECTED. 5 of 4000 high-n cells exceed |delta| 0.2; detection is 0.1045 with blowups vs 0.1046 excluding them.
impact_on_reported_results.Q2: SOUND, and for a reason worth stating: the blowups hit the PERMUTED arm at least as hard (permuted min -4.612 vs nested min -2.978), so they partially cancel in the nested-minus-permuted contrast that Q2 actually uses. Q2's medians are additionally rank-based.
impact_on_reported_results.any_future_mean_based_or_pooled_analysis: WOULD INHERIT a -7.2 outlier. This is the live risk, not the frozen results.

status_rationale: provisional. Every number here carries a rerun receipt from the frozen code path, but this is a single-author diagnosis with no independent confirmation; threshold-2 has not been met.

ruling.decision: RECORD AND DO NOT FIX. No estimator change inside the frozen replication branch.
frozen_finding: Low-frequency causal envelopes are intrinsically heavy-tailed in this dataset.
At low n, test observations can fall far outside training support.
This compromises absolute / mean-based low-n R^2.
Q2's nested-minus-permuted, rank-based inference is empirically robust to this failure.
Future pooled / mean-based analyses are not safe until support handling is defined.
ruling.why_no_remedy_now: Support control (remedy b) is the best future candidate but clipping, winsorizing or refusing extrapolation CHANGES THE ESTIMATOR and therefore breaks direct comparability with the completed three-session replication.
ruling.why_trial_254_is_not_rejected: Hamm, explicitly: the evidence shows it is extreme in theta FEATURE SPACE but is NOT a demonstrated acquisition artifact. Removing it because it damages prediction would be CIRCULAR. The trial stands.
ruling.prospective_future_work_not_retrofitted: Before any corpus-wide reuse of distributed prediction, test support control PROSPECTIVELY on synthetic plus held-out sessions. x_test not in support(X_train) becomes an explicit DIAGNOSTIC FLAG. Whether flagged observations are clipped, transformed, rejected from prediction, or handled by a nonlinear/robust estimator is to be decided FROM VALIDATION -- not retrofitted into this replication.
